sections.label: The Models
paragraphs: Kimi K3 on max effort against GPT-6 Astra on low effort. Game 1 of a ten-game series on the same pairing, each game drafted fresh.

Max effort is a draft-time expense more than a play-time one: Kimi spent 62,859 reasoning tokens on its 42 picks here, three and a half times what it used at high effort, and then played the game for $0.80 against Astra's $1.94.

sections.label: Draft
paragraphs: Picks and reasoning are [[view:draft|here]], the final lists [[view:decks|here]].

Kimi drafted a three-colour Ally deck — white and blue with a two-Forest green splash — built entirely around triggered abilities: [[card:Pretending Poxbearers]] and [[card:Earth King's Lieutenant]] into [[card:Katara, the Fearless]], who doubles Ally triggers, with [[card:Airbender Ascension]] as a repeatable blink once it reaches four quest counters.

Astra drafted Golgari lands-matter: [[card:Raucous Audience]] to ramp, [[card:Earthbender Ascension]] to animate lands into creatures, and [[card:Long Feng, Grand Secretariat|Long Feng]] as a trampling threat that grows every time something dies.

rounds.label: Turn 1
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] takes the play and leads on a tapped [[card:Foggy Bottom Swamp]], explicitly spending the turn it can afford to lose so [[card:Raucous Audience]] arrives on time.
[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] plays a Plains, already sequencing three turns ahead: Plains now for the Poxbearers, Forest next for the Lieutenant, Island after that for Katara.

rounds.label: Turn 2
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Raucous Audience]], a 2/1 that taps for mana.
[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] plays the Forest and casts [[card:Pretending Poxbearers]] on curve.

rounds.label: Turn 3
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Earthbender Ascension]] before its land drop rather than after — deliberately, to bank an extra quest counter — animates a Swamp into a creature, and fetches a Forest.

[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] attacks for 2 into a board where every possible blocker is tapped, then casts [[card:Katara, the Fearless]]. The sequencing note is the interesting part: Katara first, so that next turn's Lieutenant trigger gets doubled.

rounds.label: Turn 4
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] develops [[card:Ostrich-Horse]] and [[card:Long Feng, Grand Secretariat|Long Feng]] with six mana, holding removal for Katara.
[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] casts [[card:Airbender Ascension]] and airbends the Ostrich-Horse away while Astra is tapped out — it cannot be recast this turn — then attacks for 5 into an empty board.

rounds.label: Turn 5
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] recasts the airbent Ostrich-Horse for two mana, kills [[card:Katara, the Fearless]] with [[card:Heartless Act]] before those doubled triggers can matter, and attacks with a 3/4 trampling [[card:Long Feng, Grand Secretariat|Long Feng]]. The Horse then trades with an Ally token, and Long Feng grows on the death trigger.

[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] declines to chump-block the trampler — it would save 2 life and cost the Ally synergies — and rebuilds instead: [[card:Earth King's Lieutenant]] and [[card:South Pole Voyager]] in one turn, which together push [[card:Airbender Ascension]] to its fourth quest counter and switch on the end-step blink.

rounds.label: Turn 6
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] grows Long Feng to 5/6, animates a Swamp into a 4/4 with [[card:Rockalanche]], and attacks. Both players are on 14.

[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] casts [[card:Katara, Water Tribe's Hope]], and then the engine does what it was built for: the Ascension blinks her at end step, re-triggering her enter ability for another Ally token while [[card:South Pole Voyager]] gains life and draws. Astra is on 10, Kimi on 16, and Kimi's board is now five creatures wide.

rounds.label: Turn 7
paragraphs: [[player:PilotB|Astra]] animates a second Swamp and tries to build enough blockers, but at 10 life against five creatures it needs three of them to block profitably.

[[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] pays Katara's waterbend for X=6, making the whole team 6/6 — one token 7/7 — and attacks with everything. Three get blocked, the rest is lethal. Kimi wins on turn 14 at 18 life.

The Ally engine took six turns to assemble and one turn to win with. Astra answered every individual piece — the Ostrich-Horse came back, Katara died to [[card:Heartless Act]] — but never answered [[card:Airbender Ascension]], and the blink is what turned a board of 2/1s into a lethal attack.
